image_description: A close-up view of a vintage comic book cover titled 'CREEPY' (partially visible as 'CRE...'). The cover features grotesque, horror-themed artwork in a classic pulp style. Prominent elements include a large, screaming face with glasses and long hair in the foreground, a woman in a yellow dress floating or falling in the upper right holding a gun, and another character's head in the bottom right. The background depicts a stylized cityscape. Text elements include the title logo, a price box ('25¢'), and story titles ('Kiss of Death', 'The Man Who...'). The image exhibits signs of age, such as slight wear on the edges.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific genre (horror/comic) and authenticity of the printed material style against AI-generated approximations.
AI generators often fail at rendering coherent, legible text, especially complex logos and small print. This is a critical diagnostic for comic books.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, blending errors, or 'smearing' common in AI art that mimics painted styles.
To ensure characters do not merge into the background or each other, a common artifact in complex compositions.

focus_areas: Legibility and structural integrity of text (title, prices, captions).
Consistency of artistic style across different characters (no disjointed rendering).
Edge sharpness between foreground characters and background cityscape.
Authenticity of paper texture and print artifacts (halftone patterns, ink bleed).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text rendering. AI images often have 'gibberish' text that looks like letters from a distance but fails close inspection. Verify if the 'CREEPY' logo and the small print on the left are actually readable words or just approximate shapes. Also, check for 'melting' where the characters overlap the background buildings.
